name: plate-46-swoopy-chute
version_tag: Swoopy Poop Chute for X1/P1P/P1S (third-party, MakerWorld 93198, PDXCNC) — purge catcher, timed for plate-45, the first two-colour plate. Measured from the downloaded STL: 208.2 x 228.9 x 181.8mm, watertight, one body, 190796 tris, 164.6cm3 solid. *** THIS PLATE EXPOSED A BED BUG (#144) — read before composing anything. *** The flattened canonical config claimed printable_area 200x200 and printable_height 100 for a P1S, whose real build volume is 256x256x256. Nothing caught it because every mechanism part so far is under 45mm tall and 90mm wide — but it is why plate-41 and plate-43 both had to be reflowed by hand at the printer, and it silently capped this machine at 100mm of Z. It would have refused this 182mm chute outright. compose_plate now takes printable_area_mm / printable_height_mm from the spec (all live specs updated to 256/256/256), centres on the real envelope rather than a hard-coded 256 that disagreed with the config's 200, and GATES placement: any part off the bed, over height, inside the bed exclusion zone, or overlapping another part now fails at compose time with the offending numbers. NOT a mechanism part, so two standing settings are deliberately off: xy_contour_compensation is 0, NOT -0.06 (that exists to make posts and keys print at their mate bore size per #136; this model was drawn for nominal and shrinking its contours would tighten the chassis mount for nothing), and walls 2 / infill 10% instead of 3/25% since it is a hollow waste catcher. Quiet slicing kept, no supports (designer states none needed). 1 part, position center. | QUIET.
